name: com.alphaclip.video
description: Plays standard VP9/WebM video (and later its alpha) with a software decoder: the AlphaClip core library is loaded as a native plugin, the decoded YUV planes are uploaded as textures and converted to RGB by a shader into a RenderTexture. M4 prototype: opaque and transparent clips (native alpha, packed alpha, described by a sidecar; premultiplied output) in the Windows editor and on Android arm64.
